statement: Dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for subgaussian log-concave measures. Proves a dimension-free logarithmic Sobolev inequality for centered log-concave densities with uniformly subgaussian linear marginals, with constant bounded by a universal multiple of the squared linear subgaussian parameter.
